display.purpose: Uses the company's configured heading font, with inherited fallback.

body.purpose: Uses the company's configured body font, with the existing system sans fallback.

shadows.name: card-edge
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for white admin panels.

motion.name: directory-hover
motion.purpose: Small hover response on role filters and staff rows.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action, colored by the current tenant.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: var(--brand-primary); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--brand-primary); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-primary) 88%, #111827); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb) / 30%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White secondary action with a tenant-colored label.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { background: #fff; color: var(--brand-primary); border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #f8fafc; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb) / 30%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Staff Directory Card
components.description: White panel separating the roster from the page canvas.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(15 23 42 / 4%); font: inherit; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: White search field with a brand focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" aria-label="Search staff" placeholder="Search name, email, or role" />
components.css: .ds-search { width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; } .ds-search:focus-visible { border-color: var(--brand-primary); outline: 3px solid rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb) / 20%); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Primary Role Chip
components.description: Distinguishes the primary login role without relying on color alone.
components.css: .ds-role-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb) / 9%); color: #0f172a; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb) / 28%); border-left: 3px solid var(--brand-primary); border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 7px; font: inherit; font-size: 11px; } .ds-role-chip strong { color: inherit; font-size: 10px; }

components.name: Selected Role Filter
components.description: Shows the active access filter using the tenant primary color.
components.css: .ds-role-filter { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-height: 34px; background: var(--brand-primary); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--brand-primary); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 8px; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; } .ds-role-filter:hover { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-role-filter:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb) / 30%); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The admin workspace keeps a white canvas and familiar application typography, then uses each company's configured brand colors for primary actions, active filters, and small status accents. Content stays direct and information-dense so operators can scan a roster and take action without learning a new visual language. The people directory places role filters beside the staff list on wide screens and stacks them on narrow screens. Its primary-role chip adds a brand-colored edge to distinguish the landing role while keeping the text readable against a light surface.
keyCharacteristics: Tenant colors come from the existing brand variables.
Heading and body fonts come from company branding settings.
Neutral borders and compact controls keep large rosters easy to scan.

rules.name: The Tenant Color Rule
rules.body: Use the active company's brand variables for actions and selected states; keep headings and long-form text on neutral colors for contrast.

rules.name: The Company Type Rule
rules.body: Inherit heading and body faces from the tenant branding variables; do not add a font family in a page stylesheet.

rules.name: The White Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep page and primary content surfaces white; use borders and small tonal state cues for grouping.

dos: Do keep the page and main content surfaces white.
Do read identity colors and heading/body fonts from company branding variables.
Do use neutral text and borders for information that is not an action or status.
Do keep primary and active role states distinguishable without relying on color alone.
donts: Don't add an unconfigured typeface to a tenant-facing page.
Don't replace the company's brand colors with a fixed page palette.
Don't use a tinted canvas behind the staff directory or its primary panels.
